title: Read selected sample closes through the activated text route
context: M4-001 adds a first bounded chart question to the ordinary text connection. The workspace already selects and reads frozen CSV evidence for the local human, but the display entitlement conveys no model export rights.
decision: Offer an explicit chart scope on the Ollama route. An activated grant binds a single empty-argument tool to the named endpoint and chosen model. Use workspace.selectEvidence for the local human and resolve the exact offline snapshot against the trusted market adapter. Dispatch workspace.readChartProjection for the recipient under the profile-bound embedded AI principal using the current selection token and the fixed time_ms and close fields. Keep the sample selection in memory and serialize only its verified closed rows, range and opaque source revision. Deliver a single stateless continuation and present the actual core evidence independently of the model text.
authority: M4-001, ADR 0009, ADR 0011 and the engineering contract's field, destination and purpose rules. ScopeHub's bundled synthetic fixture generated by scopehub-synthetic-v1 affirmatively permits its selected closed times, closes and opaque source provenance for analysis by the named HTTP recipient, including a server that may forward the data. The authorization applies to that fixture only. Private CSV display and hosted or local provider adapters require their own affirmative source policy and applicable user grant.

alternatives.option: Treat a loopback address as trusted on-device analysis.
alternatives.reason: The endpoint operator may forward traffic. A network address says nothing about the runner's data processing boundary or authority.

alternatives.option: Let the provider specify a source, a range, fields or a workspace command.
alternatives.reason: The current registered selection and the exact field scope are already known to the core. Provider arguments must not extend them.

consequences: Ordinary text remains available, with the original text-only scope by default. The chart scope adds no operation write permission or private excerpt capability.

An unentitled or superseded target does not produce any tool payload. Recheck the selection and recipient before tool execution, continuation and delivery. Explicit cancellation keeps the existing grant revocation behavior.
Chart responses remain attributable in the visible conversation. Later requests do not replay earlier chart questions, results, model answers or a provider session handle.

The durable selection token still changes through the existing user operation. Synthetic evidence rows and the bound snapshot expire with the workspace process. Published CSV evidence retains its current persistence and display behavior. The database schema is unchanged.
The controlled HTTP peer verifies the adapter request and provenance. Native packaging, paid accounts and general model or market-data qualification retain their separate acceptance gates.
revisit_when: An additional provider, source, larger interval or chart operation needs a verified purpose grant and its own bounded evidence.
